statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope attributed to sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these neurological symptoms and syncope
The service addresses diagnoses I49.5 and G45.9
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-29
The denial reason is that the time limit for filing has expired
